title: A failed chat-list read is not retried until the page reloads or an erase is shown
evidence: A list read can fail in two ways, and neither is retried. (a) listConversations returns null: listLanded moves the list to read and keeps the old list (packages/health-core/src/chat-turn.ts:244), so the next list-wanted reads nothing. (b) It throws: cloudHistory() and store.listConversations() sit outside the try (widget-src/src/lib/chat-api.ts:151-153 listConversations), so readList (widget-src/src/hooks/useChatState.ts:176-178) never dispatches list-landed; the list stays reading, and the rejection reaches loadConversationsIfNeeded's callers uncaught (widget-src/src/components/ChatSection.tsx:85,97; widget-src/src/components/ChatEmbed.tsx:55). Main behaved the same before slice 3. Path (a) is pinned in useChatState.slice3-pins.test.tsx (US-15 C26); path (b) is not. The owner ruled the fix out of chat-turn slice 3 (2026-11-12). Open PR 1643 (claude/c22-c26-chat-reads) takes this on.
